question: A seller professes to sell his grapes at cost price but still gains 11.11% by using faulty weight. What weight does he use instead of 1 kg?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__Calculation:

Profit of 11.11% ⇒ C.P : S.P = 9 : 10

Here,

10 unit = 1000 gm

1 unit = 100 gm

Actual weight = 1000 - 100 = 900

∴ The correct answer is 900 gm.
